ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; ratio of high-intensity white distal patches to low-intensity black medial regions is approximately 0.45.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes feature extensive high-intensity white fields; left lobe white field is roughly triangular with internal black spots; right lobe white field is irregularly rectangular with black punctate intrusions near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; interior angle approximately 80 degrees relative to lobe horizontal axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated trailing edge with frequent peaks (3-8 pixel amplitude) and valleys along the entire span, most pronounced at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a smooth convex sweep; trailing edge lobes follow a concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, high-contrast white spots visible on the inner black region of the left lobe; additional white spots visible within the black margins of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear scratch crossing the white field of the upper-left lobe; secondary faint parallel vertical marks on the inner right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear pigmentation disruption on the left distal lobe white field consistent with rake marks; irregularities on the trailing edge tips suggesting past minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity occlusion from water droplets and spray across the peduncle and lower central fluke region.
